en.description:
iMeasure turns the sensors already in your phone into a pocket toolkit. Eleven tools behind one dark HUD interface, and every one of them works offline.

—— The tools ——

MEASURE
Tap two points on the on-screen grid, or switch to Camera: mark a bank card or an A4/Letter sheet held flat against the object, then mark the object, and the length is scaled from that reference. Camera readings are estimates and only hold when the reference is in the same plane as the object.

SCREEN RULER
Measure small objects directly against your screen, in metric or imperial, horizontally or vertically. Calibrate it once with a card for better accuracy.

LEVEL
A bubble level and a bullseye level driven by the accelerometer, for hanging a picture or checking a shelf.

COMPASS
A tilt-compensated magnetometer heading dial. Allow location and it adds true north, using the World Magnetic Model to look up the declination where you are.

PROTRACTOR
A gyroscope-backed dial for measuring angles, with lock and reset.

BAROMETER
Pressure, pressure altitude and a trend line for the session, on devices with a pressure sensor. It does not forecast weather.

PEDOMETER
Live step counting for a walking session.

UNIT CONVERTER
Six categories — length, weight, temperature, area, volume and speed — with accurate factors and proper temperature formulas rather than naive ratios.

NOISE METER
A sound-level gauge with a reference scale.

QUICK ANSWERS
An offline tips reference. Type a keyword for advice on the matching tool, or a conversion such as "6 ft 2 in to cm" and get the computed answer. It is a built-in lookup table, not AI.

RECORDS
Save readings with a label, group them into jobs and copy them out as CSV. Records stay on your device.

—— Built for real use ——

• Dark neon HUD designed to stay readable in a workshop or outdoors
• Metric and imperial throughout, remembered between sessions
• Dark and light themes
• No account needed — the app opens straight to the tools, and every tool is free

—— Honest about accuracy ——

These readings come from consumer phone sensors. They are good enough for DIY, teaching and quick checks, and they are not calibrated instruments. Do not rely on them where a wrong measurement is expensive or unsafe.

en.release_notes:
iMeasure 5.0 is a complete rebuild.

• Eleven tools behind one dark HUD: ruler, level, compass, protractor, barometer, pedometer, noise meter and a six-category unit converter
• Camera measuring scaled from a card or A4/Letter sheet held against the object
• Quick Answers: an offline tips reference that also works out unit conversions
• Everything runs offline on your device's own sensors
• No account needed — the app opens straight to the tools, and every tool is free
• Dark and light themes, metric and imperial throughout

Feedback is welcome at contact@americangroup.ai.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
iMeasure turns the sensors already in your phone into a pocket toolkit. Eleven tools behind one dark HUD interface, and every one of them works offline.

Intended audience:
Ruler, level, compass & more

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
The app opens on a sign-in screen. Test credentials are in the demo account fields of App Review Information.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Supabase — account and data storage
- Google AdMob — advertising
- Google Sign-In — authentication
- Sign in with Apple — authentication
- Apple In-App Purchase — paid features
- device location services (on-device)

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app follows the device language for 12 locales (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish), but translation is partial: shared labels are translated, while most screen text is in English only. Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
Account deletion is available in the app under Settings, and on the support site.

1. WHAT IT DOES
iMeasure turns the sensors already in your phone into a pocket toolkit. Eleven tools behind one dark HUD interface, and every one of them works offline.
Screens it contains: compass, home, home shell, level, login, measure, onboarding, premium, records, settings, splash, tools

2. INTENDED USER
People doing small practical jobs who need a measuring tool and do not have one to hand: hanging a picture, checking a shelf is level, finding a heading, measuring an angle or the size of a small object. The tools use the phone's own sensors (accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, barometer, microphone, camera) and work offline. Readings can be saved with a label, grouped into jobs and exported as CSV, which suits DIY users who want a record of their measurements.
